name: Lemon-Garlic Ricotta-Free Pasta with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 °C (or heat a pan). Toss tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast 12‑15 min until blistered.
Boil pasta in salted water until al dente; reserve ½ cup pasta water.
In a skillet, heat remaining oil, sauté garlic 30 s, add lemon zest & juice.
Drain pasta, add to skillet with a splash of pasta water, toss to coat.
Stir in roasted tomatoes, fresh basil, and toasted pine nuts; season with salt and pepper and serve.
